structure.layout: desktop app layout: thin top bar with global icon nav; left sidebar holding a collections tree and a tag cloud; main area with a page title, a pill icon toolbar, and a three-column items table (Title/Creator/Date) ending in a 'Show more' footer. Selecting a row opens a detail pane on the right (seen live)

aesthetics.typography: IBM Plex Sans throughout: 22px regular page title, 16px nav and table headers (500 weight), 14px table rows and footer, 12px count pills and tag chips
aesthetics.typeScale: Flat, restrained hierarchy: 22px/400 H1, 16px/500 column headers, 16px nav labels, 14px body rows, 12px pills. Hierarchy comes from weight and tone (#191c1c vs #3f4948) more than size

notes: Material 3-style tonal theme with teal as the seed colour (primary #006a6a, selected-nav container #aedcdb, surfaces #f2f5f4/#e6e9e8). The active collection 'My Library' is a filled teal-tint pill. Global icons sit inside a light grey pill cluster in the top bar, and the page toolbar is also a pill-shaped icon group. Count pills are tiny grey rounded rectangles. Tag chips are outlined rounded rectangles with optional coloured dots (red, orange, green, blue, purple), a count and a pencil rename button, wrapping in a cloud. Table rows have no zebra striping, only hairline dividers; the header row has a tinted fill. Rows start with item-type line icons (note, article, book, web page). Live behaviour: clicking a row narrows the table and opens a right detail card with editable fields (item-type select, author rows with drag handles and +/− controls, abstract). 'Select' toggles checkbox selection. Clicking a column header shows a ↓ arrow. Tags filter the list immediately.
